report.narrative:
Brief session, already very familiar with the full-body relaxation process and had little resistance going inward. As usual the shoulder tension kept coming back — so I kept repeating the relaxation commands targeted there.

The relaxation script will need to be updated: the commands are rushed. “Relax. Let go. Sleep” is said with 150 ms breaks.

Blåbær-coloured light at the edges, nothing identifiable… then a “click”, like a door closing. 🙂 Tab	here; a
Windows line; café, naïve, Ærø, smørbrød.
report.otherText: Heavy hands, a tingling along the spine that came and went in waves
report.title: Advanced Focus 10

report.level: Somewhere between F21 and F22, not on any published map at all
report.title: Continuous journey to the edge of the Park and the long way back again, with a stop
